name: name_saved
doc: Stands in for saves/ct_real_save.srm (the owner's battery, lifted out of saves/com_jogo_salvo.state): on the 600 A.D. overworld the party (Crono, Lucca, Frog) opens the X menu, walks the ribbon right five times to Save (the sixth icon), and saves in the empty slot 1 ('The Queen is Gone', Middle Ages); the cart RAM (the CTLS payload's last 8192 bytes) then holds slot 1 with signature E41B. Window colour 0. Slots 2-3 are erased with 00 here and FF in the owner's cart, which nothing generated from it reads.
